ov: About 3,000 species of fast, agile predatory insects with huge compound eyes and two pairs of strong wings. Most of their life is spent as underwater nymphs; adults usually live only a few weeks.
rg: Worldwide, mostly in the tropics; often near water.
df: Other insects, caught in flight. The nymphs eat almost anything smaller than themselves.
fx: Each compound eye has nearly 24,000 facets, and dragonflies see around 200 images a second.
notes: Group entry. The existing fact is confirmed: a study found dragonflies catch up to 95% of the prey they chase. Damselflies are the usual look-alike, but they aren’t on the site.
